name: Pedro Franceschi
person: Pedro Franceschi, Brazilian co-founder and CEO of Brex (corporate cards/spend management, founded 2017 with Henrique Dubugras), previously co-founded Pagar.me and Escola Squad in Brazil as a teenager before YC. NOT any other Pedro Franceschi.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (Brex Journal posts on founder mode/Brex 3.0/the Capital One deal/the 2024 restructuring memo, two Medium essays on growth mindset and mental health, the YC "CEO Must Be Chief AI Officer" talk, several StartupArchive clips).
1. Walk the Brex Journal (brex.com/journal) archive for any post authored by or quoting him at length not yet cited.
2. Look for any Brazilian-press coverage or interviews (Exame, Folha, Pipeline, Startups Brasil) about his teenage-founder years (Pagar.me, Escola Squad) or his relationship to the BR startup scene, this angle is likely thin in English-language coverage.
3. Find any 2024-2026 talk/interview specifically about AI-native company-building at Brex (headcount-vs-AI, the "chief AI officer" framing) beyond the one YC talk already cited.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the ones already known (20VC E1178 + summary, Grit/Kleiner Perkins "Brex 3.0", Core Memory EP63 + transcript, Sourcery on the Capital One acquisition, three StartupArchive clips).
1. Any 2024-2026 long-form interview discussing the Brex turnaround, the Capital One acquisition (announced 2025/2026), or IPO plans in more depth.
2. Any interview specifically about co-founding Brex with Henrique Dubugras at 19-20 years old, YC S17 batch experience, the early pivot from Brazilian teen-founder circuit to Silicon Valley, and their working co-founder dynamic (they're famously close, almost brothers).
3. Any interview about his own mental-health journey (the dossier cites one Medium essay), deeper follow-up interviews, therapy/burnout specifics, how it shaped Brex's culture.
Return exact URLs, priority-marked, 8-12 items with transcripts preferred.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} and Brex under his leadership.
1. Critiques of the 2022-2023 Brex layoffs/restructuring, the SMB-to-enterprise pivot (many small-business customers were dropped/pushed out), named critic quotes, not just news roundups.
2. Competitive critique vs. Ramp, direct comparisons, former-employee or customer commentary on why Brex fell behind Ramp in growth/valuation during the 2022-2024 period.
3. Any critique of the Capital One deal itself, analyst skepticism, employee-morale concerns, customer-transition concerns.
Return exact URLs, type=critique, 5-8 items, be honest if adversarial material is thin (he's a lower-controversy, well-liked figure relative to most of the roster).
